subject: Mythology
title: Erik the Red and the Viking Explorers
description: A short lesson to help you apply Erik the Red and the Viking Explorers.

hook.text: Erik the Red was banished from Iceland for killing two men, so he sailed west and found Greenland.

buildup.text: He named the icy land 'Greenland' to trick settlers into moving there, and it actually worked.

discovery.text: His son Leif Erikson sailed even farther west and reached North America five hundred years before Columbus.

twist.text: They called it Vinland for its wild grapes, but conflicts with the natives forced the Vikings to leave.

climax.text: Archaeological proof at L'Anse aux Meadows in Canada confirmed the sagas were not fiction but real history.

punchline.text: A banished criminal's family discovered a continent by accident.

quiz.question: Why did Erik the Red name the icy island 'Greenland'?
options: It was covered in green moss at that time
He wanted to trick settlers into moving there
The Norse word for ice sounded like green
